items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, List of Answers on Topics 83:1
items.html: The root, Neshama and Guf of Atik clothe the root, Neshama and Guf of AK, because the garment and hall of BON of AK separated from the inner ones of AK and are not there, but became surrounding ones; and likewise in all the Partzufim from there onward. (Chapter 10, Item 3)
